findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_free_tools, career_and_student_services, register_firm_account, firm_place_order, request_service, get_checkout_link · Private data: apply_as_vendor, register_firm_account, firm_place_order, request_status, cancel_booking, request_new_time, what_to_bring, verify_credential, list_datasets, get_dataset_records · Public sink: list_free_tools, register_firm_account, firm_place_order, available_times, request_service, request_status, request_new_time, get_checkout_link · Destructive: get_services_and_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_free_tools, career_and_student_services, register_firm_account, firm_place_order, request_service, get_checkout_link · Private data: apply_as_vendor, register_firm_account, firm_place_order, request_status, cancel_booking, request_new_time, what_to_bring, verify_credential, list_datasets, get_dataset_records · Public sink: list_free_tools, register_firm_account, firm_place_order, available_times, request_service, request_status, request_new_time, get_checkout_link · Destructive: get_services_and_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
